verdict.rationale: BILL's product page says Spend & Expense pairs cards with AI-powered spend management so every transaction is 'categorized and automatically compliant' (docs-9). The API supports managing card transactions (docs-2), and the accounting sync with major ERPs (docs-12) implies coded spend flows to the ledger. The evidence is marketing-level, though, and only categorization is mentioned; the AI coding agent (docs-8) applies to AP invoices, not card spend. missing for 10: evidence of receipt capture/matching at time of purchase, memo capture, merchant-level coding rules, detailed docs on how categorization works and syncs to GL, independent or hands-on corroboration.
